text:
Hi Hood iQ team — I’m Mina Castellan, a data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’m excited by the chance to support your work on data-driven insights, algorithmic analysis, and platform decision-making. My background includes building clear, reliable analytics foundations and turning messy data into actionable dashboards and reports.

In a recent confidential SaaS project, I built monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan, plus a funnel of onboarding steps. One key result was identifying an onboarding step linked to 40% of first-month churn. That work strengthened how I approach quantifying behavior patterns, validating data quality, and surfacing insights teams can act on.

I’d love to bring that same analytical discipline to Hood iQ.
